deliverable_spec.safe_area: heroes: keep the top-left third darker and free of detail (UI text sits there)

global_style: Real photography, not a render: shot like a high-end editorial or luxury-watch campaign on a full-frame camera, shallow depth of field, natural lens behaviour, true reflections, physically accurate materials (polished and toned silver with micro-scratches, gold, brass, marble, walnut, velvet, glass), soft volumetric light with physically correct falloff, rich but natural colour grading, fine film grain. The subject is always real-looking coins or bullion in a place that fits the mood. Calm, expensive, cinematic. Leave the top-left third of the frame quiet and darker (UI text sits there).
negative: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no people's faces, no hands, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D-render look, no plastic, no oversaturation, no HDR halos, no fantasy glow orbs, no duplicate coins melting into each other, no warped or unreadable coin designs
coin_rule: Coins must look like real circulated or uncirculated world coins (a generic portrait or eagle or crest design is fine); never invent a legible inscription.

images.prompt: Camera: 100 mm macro, f/4, eye level with the coin, slight 10-degree downward tilt. Subject: a single silver crown-size coin standing on edge, leaning against a large faceted optical-crystal prism (K9 glass, razor-sharp facets) on a black polished obsidian slab. One narrow beam of pure white light enters from frame-left, passes through the prism and fans into a clean, physically correct rainbow spectrum (red to violet) that lands across the coin's face and rim; secondary caustics sparkle on the obsidian. Background: pure black. Composition: coin at the right third, prism at centre-left, the top-left third left dark for UI text.

Extreme macro (2:1) of the reeded rim and edge of a silver coin seen through one facet of a crystal prism; three crisp spectral bands cross it diagonally; black background; ultra sharp, no bokeh balls.

Camera: 35 mm, f/2.8, low and wide, 1.2 m off the floor. A private coin museum after closing: double-height room, black Nero Marquina marble floor polished to a mirror, a high glass skylight letting in cold moonlight (5600 K, soft beams with faint dust). In the centre, one bronze-framed glass vitrine on a dark plinth; inside, three silver coins on navy velvet under a single warm 3000 K pin spot. Brass label rail on the plinth (no readable text). The rest of the room falls into deep shadow with long soft reflections on the floor. Top-left third dark.
Close-up, 85 mm, f/2: three silver coins fanned on navy velvet under one warm pin spot, cool moonlit blue rim on the vitrine glass edge, black marble reflection below, shallow depth of field.

images.world: Fireside Den (Moods, the cozy sound-machine world)
images.prompt: Camera: 35 mm, f/2.8, seated eye height. A wood-panelled private study at night: a stone fireplace frame-right with a real oak-log fire (warm 1900-2200 K flicker), a worn cognac leather wingback armchair, and a low walnut table in the foreground with an open coin album (round coin slots, some filled with silver coins) and three loose silver coins catching the firelight. A tall window frame-left with snow falling outside in cool blue night light. Warm amber versus cool blue. Top-left third (the window area) stays darker.
85 mm macro, f/2: three silver coins on a walnut tabletop lit by firelight, a soft orange fireplace glow behind them, a cool blue window-light rim on the left edge, shallow depth of field.

Underwater, 24 mm, f/5.6, 40 m deep, natural light only. The broken oak ribs of an old Spanish galleon frame-left, half buried in pale sand; in the foreground a scattered heap of irregular silver 'cob' coins, some black-encrusted and some gleaming where the sand has worn them, and a small brass-bound chest lid. God rays fall from the surface, rippling caustic light plays over the coins, fine particles drift. Colour: deep teal to black. Top-left third dark water.
Macro, 60 mm: four silver cob coins in pale sand, caustic light ripples across them, teal water, a few particles, shallow depth of field.

Camera: 50 mm, f/2.8. Inside an 18th-century coin mint at night: frame-right, a thin stream of molten silver pours from a graphite crucible into an iron ingot mould with a few real sparks; centre-back, a massive iron screw coining press with a long weighted arm; foreground, a steel tray of freshly struck, mirror-bright silver coins. Ember light, light smoke, dark brick walls, warm 2000 K only. Top-left third in shadow.
Macro, 100 mm: freshly struck bright silver coins stacked on a steel tray, a soft out-of-focus ember glow and two sparks behind, shallow depth of field.

Square 1024x1024. One perfectly lit polished silver coin (generic portrait relief, no readable lettering) seen at a 20-degree angle, centred, filling 62% of the square, on a deep ink-black background with a very subtle radial falloff; one soft white rim highlight on the upper-left edge and a faint reflection below. Must read clearly at 48 px: strong silhouette, high contrast, nothing small. No text, no border, no rounded-corner mask (the phone adds it).

Square 1024x1024. A neat stack of three coins (silver, gold, silver; generic designs, no readable text) photographed from slightly above on a warm ivory background, crisp soft shadow, centred, filling 60%. High contrast at 48 px. No text, no border, no mask.

Portrait 1080x1920 (9:16). A massive round steel vault door, half open, seen straight on and slightly from below; a blade of warm light spills from inside across a polished black floor; inside, a glimpse of a single silver coin on black velvet and two silver bars, softly glowing. The top 15% and bottom 20% are near-black empty space (for the app's caption and buttons). Moody, restrained, expensive.
